publications.title: A JoLT for the KV Cache
publications.description: My MSc thesis preprint reports near-lossless 2x to 3x KV cache compression within a 2 percentage point noninferiority bound across five models and four model families.

publications.title: Structural Companion Study on Tensor Decompositions for the KV Cache
publications.conference: In preparation, targeting SIAM Journal on Mathematics of Data Science (SIMODS)
publications.description: Volker Schulz and I are preparing this structural and theoretical companion to the JoLT method paper.

publications.title: Glaucoma Detection from Retinal Fundus Images
publications.conference: International Conference on Communication and Signal Processing (ICCSP)
publications.description: I co-authored this paper on glaucoma screening from retinal fundus images using region growing and SVM classification. The paper reports an F1 score of 86%.
